title: Different experience renews a shared custom
meaning: Combining different ways of participating through understood experience is emotionally answered by belonging to a shared custom or value.
text: A shared custom can include different ways of being part of it. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field concerns shared actions that combine different needs and forms of participation. The Hermit in energy motivates drawing on understood experience and sharing what has become clear. The Hierophant in emotions adds belonging to a recognised meaning. The overall tone can be thoughtful and continuous: you practically combine differences using earlier understanding, while emotionally recognising the value of a familiar occasion within a revised sequence of actions.

For example, you prepare an evening of memories together. One person gathers short stories, while the other chooses objects that may help recall them. Experience of earlier gatherings suggests leaving time both for speaking and for quietly looking at things. **Our different ways of participating help us feel the gathering’s shared meaning again.** The pleasant response concerns belonging; it does not require everyone to speak, listen or assess every keepsake in the same way. Different forms of attention can support the occasion.

A difficulty arises if experience becomes the correct script that must now suit both people. Changed interest then seems disrespectful to the custom, and combination becomes merely formal. The Hermit guarantees no universal past conclusion, and the Hierophant in emotions makes no tradition compulsory. Temperance in action allows the relationship between contributions to change when you understand the occasion differently and need another place for responses that no longer coincide.
